axe.help: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
eg: .wine-row:nth-child(3) > .wine-info > .wine-sub > span:nth-child(1) ::   Element has insufficient color contrast of 3.55 (foreground color: #6a6a6a, background color: #f9c6ba, font size: 8.3pt (11px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1

.wine-row:nth-child(3) > .wine-info > .wine-sub > span:nth-child(2) ::   Element has insufficient color contrast of 3.55 (foreground color: #6a6a6a, background color: #f9c6ba, font size: 8.3pt (11px), font weight: normal). Expected contrast ratio of 4.5:1

axe.help: Document should have one main landmark
eg: html ::   Document does not have a main landmark

axe.help: Page should contain a level-one heading
eg: html ::   Page must have a level-one heading

axe.help: All page content should be contained by landmarks
eg: #wine-content ::   Some page content is not contained by landmarks
